name: @inf-studio/collab
description: Cross-session collaboration for OpenCode: twenty-seven native collab_* tools, resource leases (exclusive/shared + TTL + FIFO queue), a thread/inbox protocol, delivery acknowledgement (admitted/seen), bounded resend, a cross-workspace hand-off chain (broadcast / score / atomic claim / receipt), a pull-only review queue for protected sessions, automatic (reversible) archival of spawned sessions, a workspace facts ledger (settle / retract / invalidate, evidence grades, three-state freshness, pair glossary), a rebuildable SQLite projection of the message history, and read-only status views for the desktop sidebar and the TUI (experimental).

scripts.build: vp pack && vp build -c vite.gui.config.ts && vp build -c vite.tui.config.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node test/facts.mjs && node test/handoff-harness.mjs && node test/readonly-default.mjs && node test/board-shape.mjs && node test/graph-shape.mjs && node test/snapshot-shape.mjs && node test/store-rebuild.mjs && node test/contract-inject.mjs && node test/drift.mjs && node test/gate.mjs && node test/delivery-history.mjs && node --conditions=browser test/tui-render.mjs && node --conditions=browser test/gui-entry.mjs && node --conditions=browser test/gui-panel.mjs
